dedupe_keys.name: uk infrastructure pipeline interactive dashboard of public and private infrastructure projects nista

description: The UK Infrastructure Pipeline, published by the National Infrastructure and Service Transformation Authority (NISTA), the body that now runs the former National Infrastructure Commission site, underpins the government's 10 Year Infrastructure Strategy. It gives industry and investors current information on public and privately delivered infrastructure projects in construction, under development or at pre-project stages where a strategic need has been prioritised by the government or in business plans. It lists capital construction and maintenance projects and programmes expected to exceed 25 million pounds for economic infrastructure (transport, utilities and energy) and 15 million pounds for other infrastructure such as education, health and defence. The pipeline is an interactive online dashboard with each scheme's anticipated spend, current status and expected completion; its second version adds workforce requirement modelling and more on private investment, such as revenue models. It was first published on 17 July 2025, with an update announced on 9 March 2026. Coverage: United Kingdom. Format and access: an interactive dashboard; free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): OGL-UK-3.0 (GOV.UK: all content under the Open Government Licence v3.0 unless otherwise stated). Caveats: the dashboard is rendered by scripts and could not be read from the cloud, so its fields and any export were not checked. Simulation uses: planned infrastructure projects, spend and timing for capacity planning and future network scenarios. Related records: New Zealand's Te Waihanga pipeline (data-te-waihanga-national-infrastructure-pipeline) and the Australian pipeline reports (data-ipa-anzip-infrastructure-pipeline-reports) are comparable.
